5 Best AI Video Generators to Create 1-Minute Videos in 2026

Want to create one-minute videos without filming everything yourself? Discover AI video generators that can turn text prompts, images and ideas into engaging video content.

By LokkeeVerse · 4 min read

Creating a one-minute video no longer requires an expensive camera, a professional studio or advanced editing skills. AI video generators can help you turn ideas into short clips for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and other social platforms.

Whether you want cinematic scenes, animated stories, product videos or faceless content, these tools can make the creative process easier.

Here are five AI video generators worth exploring in 2026.

1. Runway

Runway is an AI-powered creative platform designed to help users generate and edit video content.

You can experiment with text-to-video and image-to-video features to create visual scenes from written descriptions or existing images.

It is worth exploring if you want cinematic visuals, creative effects or short clips for storytelling.

2. Kling AI

Kling AI is known for generating videos from text prompts and images. It can help creators bring still images to life and produce scenes featuring movement.

You could use it to create fictional movie scenes, product demonstrations, animated environments or short visual stories.

The results depend on the prompt, selected model and available features.

3. Pika

Pika is an AI video creation tool aimed at making visual experimentation accessible to creators.

It can help users turn ideas into short video clips and explore creative transformations.

It may be useful for entertaining social media videos, unusual visual effects and imaginative content.

4. Luma AI

Luma AI offers generative video tools that can help creators develop cinematic scenes from text and images.

It is worth considering for concept videos, atmospheric visuals and storytelling projects where movement and visual style matter.

Check the current model features and generation limits before choosing a plan.

5. InVideo AI

InVideo AI focuses on helping users create videos from prompts and scripts. Depending on the available features, it can assist with assembling scenes, narration and other elements into a video.

It is worth considering if you want to produce explainers, list videos, educational content or social media videos without editing every scene manually.

How to Create a One-Minute AI Video

Follow these steps to get started.

  • Choose a topic, such as a mystery story, motivational message or interesting fact.
  • Write a short script with a strong opening, a clear middle and an ending.
  • Break the script into several scenes instead of asking one generation to produce everything.
  • Generate clips using your preferred AI video tool.
  • Arrange the clips in a video editor and add narration, captions and suitable sound.
  • Export the finished video in a vertical format for TikTok, Reels or YouTube Shorts.

Try This AI Video Prompt

Create a cinematic 60-second video about a futuristic city at night. Show flying vehicles moving between skyscrapers, glowing blue advertisements, crowded streets and dramatic aerial views. Use realistic lighting, smooth camera movements and a mysterious science-fiction atmosphere. Divide the concept into short scenes suitable for a vertical social media video.

Generate the scenes separately if the tool cannot produce the entire sequence in one generation.

Are AI Video Generators Free?

Some AI video platforms offer free access or trial credits, while others require payment for additional generations, higher-quality exports or advanced features.

Availability, pricing and usage limits can change, so check each platform's current plan before starting a project.

Final Thoughts

AI video generators can make short-form content creation easier, especially for creators who want to publish regularly without filming every scene themselves.

Runway, Kling AI, Pika, Luma AI and InVideo AI offer different approaches to video creation. Test them with the same prompt and compare visual quality, motion, generation limits and cost before choosing your favourite.
